name: AI Humanizer & AI Detector – Uncertify AI
author: uncertifyai

sections.description:
UncertifyAI Content Tools is a powerful WordPress plugin that integrates with the UncertifyAI API to provide advanced AI content detection and humanization capabilities.

Features:

  • AI Detection: Analyze your content to detect AI-generated text with probability scores
  • AI Humanization: Transform AI-generated content into more human-like text
  • Usage Tracking: Monitor your API usage with detailed statistics and limits
  • Automatic Checking: Configure automatic content checking for posts, pages, and specific categories
  • Revision History: Track changes and recheck content with full revision history
  • Frontend Display: Optionally show AI certification symbols and results to visitors
  • Comprehensive Dashboard: Get insights with a detailed dashboard widget and results page

Perfect For:

  • Content creators who want to ensure their content is authentic
  • Website owners who need to verify content quality
  • Editors who want to maintain high editorial standards
  • SEO professionals looking to optimize content quality

External Services

This plugin connects to the UncertifyAI API service to perform AI content detection and humanization. This service is required for the plugin’s core functionality.

What data is sent:
– Content text for analysis
– API key for authentication
– Website URL for usage tracking

When data is sent:
– When manually checking content via the admin interface
– When automatic checking is enabled for posts/pages
– When using the humanization feature

Service Information:
– Service Provider: UncertifyAI
– Terms of Service: https://uncertifyai.com/terms-of-service
– Privacy Policy: https://uncertifyai.com/privacy-policy
– Refund Policy: https://uncertifyai.com/refund-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the uncertifyai-content-tools folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings → UncertifyAI and configure your API key
  4. Configure your automatic checking preferences and display settings
sections.faq:
How do I get an API key?

You can get an API key by signing up at UncertifyAI.

What content types can be checked?

You can configure the plugin to check posts, pages, and specific categories automatically.

Can I see the history of checks?

Yes, the plugin maintains a complete history of all checks with revision tracking.

Is my content sent to UncertifyAI’s servers?

Yes, content is sent to UncertifyAI’s API for analysis. Please review our privacy policy for details on how we handle your data.

What is your refund policy?

We offer a 14-day money-back guarantee for new subscriptions. Please see our complete Refund Policy at https://uncertifyai.com/refund-policy for details and exceptions.
